units.source_text: 应该说，对局室简直是鬼气逼人。

en.t: It must be said, the game room was simply filled with a terrifying, ghostly air.

units.source_text: 站在走廊上，偶然俯视夏阳灿烂的庭院，

en.t: Standing in the corridor, I happened to look down at the courtyard bright with summer sunlight,

units.source_text: 看见一位摩登小姐热衷于给池子里的鲤鱼投麸饼，

en.t: and saw a modern young lady absorbed in tossing wheat gluten cakes to the carp in the pond,

units.source_text: 我就像望着什么奇异的东西，甚至不相信那是同一个世界的事。

en.t: I felt as if I were looking at something strange, and could hardly believe it belonged to the same world.
